name: Puppeteer 1.1.3
body:
**New Features/Changes:**
- Auto Role experiment updates
  - More reliable and no longer blocks talent requests from others while finding roles
  - Changed Discipline Priest from Healer to Damage
- Enemy frames no longer populate with your teammates while you're mind controlled
- Added many debuffs from Timbermaw Hold to the tracked list
- Reduced AoE heal predict range of Prayer of Healing from 30 to 28 yd, since it is actually 28 yd despite the description
- Your own pet is now sorted above other players’ pets
